subject: Post-call: Everleaf pilot scope, risks, and suggested MAP
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Porter <leah.porter@everleaf.health>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-17T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Everleaf pilot scope, risks, and suggested MAP

Hi Leah — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have a single source of truth. Please confirm or correct anything below.

What we heard (pain & impact)
- Primary pain: production hallucinations and unpredictable latency on current vendor (3–5s tail latency on long contexts) causing poor clinician trust and drop in adoption.
- Security: PHI handling and residency requirements — Everleaf needs evidence of SOC 2 + support for VPC/private deployment for live PHI.
- Cost/governance: current per-token costs limiting scale; want predictable monthly commit for pilot to evaluate unit economics.

Goals for the pilot
- 6-week pilot: 50k inference requests/day using clinical QA and triage workflows; measure latencies, quality (precision for entity extraction), and unit cost.
- SLA target for pilot: median <300ms, p95 <900ms (for default prompts); failover to hosted variant for edge cases.
- Security: complete security questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence before data ingress.

Suggested MAP (owners & dates)
1) Pilot kickoff & environment prep — Week of 2026-09-27 (Owner: Everleaf eng + Redwood ops)
2) Security review & SOC 2 docs exchange — 2026-09-24 (Owner: Leah / Everleaf security)
3) Test dataset delivery (anonymized) — 2026-10-04 (Owner: Everleaf data lead)
4) Pilot run & evaluation (6 weeks) — 2026-10-11 through 2026-11-22 (Owner: Marissa / Redwood PM)
5) Procurement & contract execution — target 2026-10-08 (Owner: Everleaf procurement)
6) Production rollout planning — target decision meeting 2026-11-29

Open questions / risks (please flag)
- Do you require on-prem deployment or will VPC with customer-managed keys be sufficient for the pilot?
- Legal: any non-standard SLAs or indemnities we should expect in procurement?
- Data access: will the anonymized QA set be ready by 10/04?

Attachments: I attached a light SOC 2 extract and a first-pass MAP spreadsheet for editable milestones (mutual-action-plan.xlsx, everleaf-soc2-extract.pdf).

Next step: If that timeline looks reasonable I’ll schedule a 30-minute MAP alignment meeting for next Tuesday (2026-09-21) with engineering, security, and procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai
From: Leah Porter <leah.porter@everleaf.health>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@everleaf.health
Date: 2026-09-17T18:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Everleaf pilot scope, risks, and suggested MAP

Maya — thanks for the clear summary. This matches our notes. A few items from our side: 

- Security: we need the SOC 2 extract and an architecture diagram for the VPC/private option. Can you confirm who on your side will provide the diagram?
- Procurement: our procurement lead (procurement@everleaf.health) asked for an indicative cost estimate for the 6-week pilot and any minimum commit required to enable private deployment.
- Timeline: we have a privacy committee review week of 10/04 so the test dataset deadline would be tight — if we can push the dataset delivery to 10/08 would that still align?

I’ll also include our legal contact on follow-ups once we have an initial SOW. Attaching our internal PCI/HIPAA checklist for reference (see everleaf-pci-requirements.pdf).

Would appreciate if Ben or Marissa can confirm technical fit (VPC + KMS) and estimated pilot costs.

-Leah
Leah Porter
VP Clinical Operations
Everleaf Health
leah.porter@everleaf.health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Leah Porter <leah.porter@everleaf.health>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-18T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Everleaf pilot scope, risks, and suggested MAP

Thanks for assembling this, Maya. Quick technical answers: 
- VPC/private deployment with customer-managed KMS is supported for the pilot; we’ll need a short network runbook from Everleaf to open the required egress/ingress. I’ll coordinate with our infra team.
- Pilot sizing/cost: for 50k rps/day and the workload shape you described I recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) for predictable latency and cost; ballpark estimate for the 6-week pilot with a small reserved pool + burst is ~$28k — I’ll share a more detailed breakdown if that helps procurement.
- I’m assigning Marissa to lead implementation and to own the MAP execution; she’ll coordinate the security artifact exchange and schedule a technical kickoff.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Porter <leah.porter@everleaf.health>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@everleaf.health
Date: 2026-09-18T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Everleaf pilot scope, risks, and suggested MAP

Leah / team — I updated the MAP spreadsheet with owners, firm dates where we agreed, and a few action items for the kickoff. See attached mutual-action-plan.xlsx.

Immediate asks before kickoff:
- Leah: confirm dataset delivery on 2026-10-08 (OK to be pseudonymized/anonymized).
- Procurement: please confirm whether a one-month deposit or a PO is preferred to start reserved capacity.
- Everleaf security: send the network diagram or a short runbook so we can validate firewall rules.

I’ll book the 30-minute MAP alignment for 2026-09-21 11:00 AM ET and share an invite — please tell me if that slot conflicts.

If there are no objections I’ll push the updated MAP to the HubSpot deal and the shared Drive folder (links below).

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9473 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF

—
